title: What makes a layout migration recoverable?
question: What makes a layout migration recoverable?
answer:
V3-16: A one-time, recoverable v3 migration using the same manifest, path, and missing-only skill rules as Adoption.
V3-16A: Move affected durable records, update links/tools/scopes, remove legacy local skill shadows only after the presence gate, and retain the migration result in the owning spec evidence.
V3-16B: Record the pre-migration Git recovery point, preserve or back up every retired path before removal, verify the new paths and references, and leave no unattributed dirty residue.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: V3-16, V3-16A, V3-16B (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
